```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)

# Set knitr options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# Preset definitions
preset_list <- list(
  "Okabe-Ito (Qualitative, Gold Standard)" = list(
    colors = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#000000"),
    type = "qualitative",
    safe = TRUE,
    scale_col = 'scale_color_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#000000"))'
  ),
  "Viridis (Sequential, CVD Uniform)" = list(
    colors = c("#440154", "#482878", "#3E4A89", "#31688E", "#26828E", "#1F9E89", "#35B779", "#6DCD59", "#B4DE2C", "#FDE725"),
    type = "sequential",
    safe = TRUE,
    scale_col = "scale_color_viridis_d(option = 'viridis')"
  ),
  "Cividis (Sequential, Optimized CVD)" = list(
    colors = c("#00204D", "#1B315A", "#334467", "#4A5774", "#616A82", "#797F8F", "#92949D", "#ADACAC", "#CAC5BC", "#EAE5CC"),
    type = "sequential",
    safe = TRUE,
    scale_col = "scale_color_viridis_d(option = 'cividis')"
  ),
  "RColorBrewer: Dark2" = list(
    colors = c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "#66A61E", "#E6AB02", "#A6761D", "#666666"),
    type = "qualitative",
    safe = TRUE,
    scale_col = "scale_color_brewer(palette = 'Dark2')"
  ),
  "RColorBrewer: Blues" = list(
    colors = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#C6DBEF", "#9ECAE1", "#6BAED6", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C", "#08306B"),
    type = "sequential",
    safe = TRUE,
    scale_col = "scale_color_brewer(palette = 'Blues')"
  ),
  "RColorBrewer: RdBu (Diverging)" = list(
    colors = c("#67001F", "#B2182B", "#D6604D", "#F4A582", "#FDDBC7", "#FFFFFF", "#D1E5F0", "#92C5DE", "#4393C3", "#2166AC", "#053061"),
    type = "diverging",
    safe = TRUE,
    scale_col = "scale_color_brewer(palette = 'RdBu')"
  )
)
```

## Interactive Designer

Designed specifically for the compact dimensions of the RStudio Tutorial Pane.

```{r studio_ui, echo=FALSE}
fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5, bg = "#FFFFFF", fg = "#0F172A", primary = "#2563EB"),
  
  # Collapsible Accessibility Bar
  div(
    style = "padding: 4px 8px; background: #F8FAFC; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px;",
    fluidRow(
      column(
        6,
        checkboxInput("cb_safe_only", label = tags$span(style="font-size:11px; font-weight:500;", "CVD Safe Only"), value = FALSE)
      ),
      column(
        6,
        selectInput(
          "cvd_mode",
          label = NULL,
          choices = c(
            "Vision: Normal" = "normal",
            "Protanopia" = "protan",
            "Deuteranopia" = "deutan",
            "Tritanopia" = "tritan",
            "Grayscale" = "grayscale"
          ),
          selected = "normal",
          width = "100%"
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  
  # Tab navigation
  tabsetPanel(
    id = "main_tabs",
    type = "pills",
    
    # Tab 1: Custom Palette (vector output default)
    tabPanel(
      "Custom",
      div(style = "padding-top: 6px;",
        div(
          style = "display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 6px;",
          actionButton("add_swatch", "+ Add", class = "btn-sm btn-primary"),
          actionButton("delete_swatch", "Remove", class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary")
        ),
        uiOutput("custom_swatches_ui")
      )
    ),
    
    # Tab 2: Preset Palettes (Sub-tabs for Qualitative & Sequential, ggplot layer default)
    tabPanel(
      "Presets",
      div(style = "padding-top: 6px;",
        radioButtons("preset_type_sub", NULL, choices = c("Qualitative", "Sequential"), inline = TRUE),
        selectInput("preset_choice", "Palette:", choices = names(preset_list), width = "100%"),
        sliderInput("preset_n", "Colors (n):", min = 2, max = 10, value = 5, step = 1, width = "100%"),
        checkboxInput("enable_prune", "Edge Pruning", value = FALSE),
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.enable_prune == true",
          sliderInput("trim_range", "Trim Cutoff (%):", min = 0, max = 100, value = c(0, 100), step = 5, width = "100%")
        ),
        actionButton("import_preset_to_custom", "Import to Custom", class = "btn-sm btn-dark w-100")
      )
    ),
    
    # Tab 3: Gradient Builder (Reorderable anchors, asymmetric steps)
    tabPanel(
      "Gradient",
      div(style = "padding-top: 6px;",
        fluidRow(
          column(6, colourpicker::colourInput("k1_col", "K1:", value = "#440154")),
          column(6, sliderInput("steps_k1_k2", "Steps to K2:", min = 1, max = 6, value = 2))
        ),
        fluidRow(
          column(6, colourpicker::colourInput("k2_col", "K2:", value = "#21908C")),
          column(6, sliderInput("steps_k2_k3", "Steps to K3:", min = 1, max = 6, value = 2))
        ),
        fluidRow(
          column(6, colourpicker::colourInput("k3_col", "K3:", value = "#FDE725"))
        ),
        actionButton("import_gradient_to_custom", "Import to Custom", class = "btn-sm btn-dark w-100")
      )
    ),
    
    # Tab 4: ggplot Shape Selector
    tabPanel(
      "Shapes",
      div(style = "padding-top: 6px;",
        selectInput("shape_preset", "Shape Combo:",
          choices = c(
            "Solid (16, 17, 15, 18)" = "solid",
            "Fillable (21, 22, 24, 25)" = "fillable",
            "Hollow (1, 2, 0, 5)" = "open"
          ),
          width = "100%"
        ),
        uiOutput("shapes_mapping_ui")
      )
    )
  ),
  
  hr(style="margin: 8px 0;"),
  
  # Live ggplot2 plot output (Clean white theme)
  plotOutput("live_preview_plot", height = "190px"),
  
  # Live R Code Generator (Minimal)
  div(
    style = "margin-top: 8px;",
    tags$div(style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; color:#475569; margin-bottom:2px;", "R Code:"),
    verbatimTextOutput("live_r_code")
  )
)
```

```{r studio_server, context="server"}
# Reactive state for custom swatches
custom_colors <- reactiveVal(c("#1F77B4", "#FF7F0E", "#2CA02C"))

# Add swatch
observeEvent(input$add_swatch, {
  cols <- custom_colors()
  palette_pool <- c("#D62728", "#9467BD", "#8C564B", "#E377C2", "#7F7F7F", "#BCBD22", "#17BECF")
  next_col <- palette_pool[(length(cols) %% length(palette_pool)) + 1]
  custom_colors(c(cols, next_col))
})

# Remove swatch
observeEvent(input$delete_swatch, {
  cols <- custom_colors()
  if (length(cols) > 1) {
    custom_colors(cols[-length(cols)])
  }
})

# Dynamic custom swatches UI
output$custom_swatches_ui <- renderUI({
  cols <- custom_colors()
  lapply(seq_along(cols), function(i) {
    fluidRow(
      style = "margin-bottom: 4px;",
      column(4, textInput(paste0("swatch_label_", i), label = NULL, value = paste0("c", i))),
      column(8, colourpicker::colourInput(paste0("swatch_val_", i), label = NULL, value = cols[i]))
    )
  })
})

# Transform colors based on CVD selection using colorspace
sim_colors <- function(cols, mode) {
  if (mode == "protan") return(colorspace::protan(cols))
  if (mode == "deutan") return(colorspace::deutan(cols))
  if (mode == "tritan") return(colorspace::tritan(cols))
  if (mode == "grayscale") return(colorspace::desaturate(cols))
  return(cols)
}

# Live Plot Output
output$live_preview_plot <- renderPlot({
  tab <- input$main_tabs
  cvd <- input$cvd_mode
  
  if (tab == "Shapes") {
    pchs <- switch(input$shape_preset,
      "solid" = c(16, 17, 15, 18),
      "fillable" = c(21, 22, 24, 25),
      "open" = c(1, 2, 0, 5),
      c(16, 3, 17, 4)
    )
    cols <- sim_colors(custom_colors()[1:min(length(pchs), length(custom_colors()))], cvd)
    
    df <- iris[1:60, ]
    df$Species <- factor(rep(paste("Class", 1:length(pchs)), length.out = nrow(df)))
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species, shape = Species)) +
      geom_point(size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = pchs) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste("Point Scale Preview (CVD:", cvd, ")"))
    return(p)
  }
  
  cols <- sim_colors(custom_colors(), cvd)
  df <- data.frame(
    Category = factor(paste("Group", seq_along(cols)), levels = paste("Group", seq_along(cols))),
    Value = seq(10, by = 5, length.out = length(cols))
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Category, y = Value, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste("Palette Preview (CVD:", cvd, ")"), y = "Value", x = NULL)
})

# Live R Code Generator
output$live_r_code <- renderText({
  tab <- input$main_tabs
  if (tab == "Custom") {
    cols <- custom_colors()
    return(paste0('c("', paste(cols, collapse = '", "'), '")'))
  }
  
  if (tab == "Presets") {
    choice <- input$preset_choice
    return(preset_list[[choice]]$scale_col)
  }
  
  cols <- custom_colors()
  paste0('c("', paste(cols, collapse = '", "'), '")')
})
```

## Interactive Practice Exercise

Test your palette with live R execution:

```{r practice_palette, exercise=TRUE}
# Try out your custom palette:
my_palette <- c("#1F77B4", "#FF7F0E", "#2CA02C")

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_palette) +
  theme_minimal()
```
